name: Immuch360
summary:
Immuch360 is the Immich mobile app with the missing parts for 360° media, built for the Quest 3 and 3S. Press the 360° button on a 360° photo or video and look around by turning your head. Stereoscopic files (top and bottom, side by side) are shown in true 3D, and VR180 files are drawn on a half sphere.
